bosses.name: Battle-Hardened Domovoy Sculptor: Gale Hewing
mechanics: Starts with 90% all resistance. About 8 seconds into combat, it begins sculpting an ice statue and repeats this about every 16 seconds.

Apply Radiance: Stellar Glimmer during sculpting to interrupt the statue. The detonation deals 1,000,000 HP damage and reduces RES by 25 percentage points for Anemo or 20 for other elements; up to 3 stacks.
The ice sculptures cannot generate Superconduct stacks.
Big-Mouthed Jack Frost: interrupt the Prime Ice sculpture or it becomes a hostile animal statue that launches snowballs.
Creative Frenzy: the ley-line disturbance increases starting RES and statue frequency; the harmless statue explosion reduces all RES and further reduces Anemo RES, up to 3 stacks.
bosses.note: The selected window applies the listed resistance by damage element. The damage model does not simulate the statue timing or its fixed 1,000,000 HP backlash.

bosses.name: Secret Source Automaton: Overseer Device - Obliterator Panoply
mechanics: Immediately enters Sweeper Mode with 200% all RES. Flow Momentum rises while it attacks; Cryo hits lower it and can stop the spin.
Cryo hits faster than once every 0.6 seconds can trigger a first-threshold event that grants 36 Energy to the party once Flow Momentum falls below its threshold.
When stunned, Cryo RES falls to -30%; other RES falls to 30%.
Nightsoul Mode has 110% all RES and summons two tracking pillars. Keep its gauge at zero to stop them.
Forced Counterstrike Mode can lower RES further, but the source does not publish a fixed numeric resistance for that sub-phase.
Each Sweeper cycle can produce additional Elemental Orbs the first time its spin is stopped.
bosses.note: Choose the phase that matches your damage window. Enter the actual boss particle/orb event in Energy; the calculator starts every character at 0 Energy.

bosses.name: Guardian Blade of Drifting Snow: Endless Reverberation

phases.name: Before shield break · resistance not listed

mechanics: HP cannot initially fall below 80%. Near 81% HP, it creates a 42U Cryo Shield; this can happen up to twice.
If Stellar Glimmer affects the Cryo Shield, its remaining shield percentage converts to an HP shield worth up to 15% of max HP.
Destroying the shield removes 10% of boss HP and sets all RES to -40% for 10 seconds.
If it became an HP shield, shield break also deals up to 9% max-HP backlash, based on the inherited shield amount.
Shield hits can trigger Favonius and Sacrificial passives. If the shield survives 20 seconds, the boss restores 10% HP.
Ice Coffin: Twinned Crystal Lattice: the boss gains a Cryo Ward; destroying the coffin weakens it, while failure restores HP and triggers a counterattack.
Ice Coffin: Warped Crystal Lattice: Radiance converts the Cryo Ward into a damage-absorbing shield; breaking it causes heavy backlash.
bosses.note: The page does not list a numeric pre-shield RES value. Keep or enter your own resistance for that window; the after-break window is a verified -40% all-RES state for 10 seconds.
